summary: The agent called Robert Vance about a $650 delinquent payment. The customer said his account was compromised and he was charged twice, using profanity. The agent warned about the language, offered to review the billing history, and escalated the issue to the billing disputes team. The customer asked for the issue to be fixed and proof sent by email.
